fusions.name: Hurled Shoal
fusions.desc: Opens your palm and flings 5 darting fish ahead, each dealing 4 water damage, knocking the target back 2.5 tiles and with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Slap
fusions.desc: A slap with a slick, wet palm on one enemy up to 3 tiles away that deals 4 water damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Squirm Loose
fusions.desc: You twist free of every grip on you: for 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slithers Free
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a blow that would have landed on you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
